front.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING

"'Operation LION'S TOOTH.' This is what the Soviets call their MEDUSA deployment plan, and we need to know more. A Soviet spy posing as a businessman, last seen in Sydney, has this information. Find him.

Your second objective is to dig deeper into PEARL compound; locate and sabotage the MEDUSA manufacturing equipment. Finally, Sabik is laying low, but many of his allies are parting ways with him. Find one."

Open the following doors:
U 39 42 S

back.transcription:
FOLLOWING UP

"We followed your leads on MEDUSA deployment. Here is what we discovered."

Take your MEDUSA Deployment Report out of your Intelligence file.
Note your answer, then read the appropriate debrief:

Jellyfish: Read Debrief 126
Agent Sabik: Read Debrief 209
Pollen: Read Debrief 140
We Don't Know: Read Debrief 120
back.flavor: "We followed your leads on MEDUSA deployment. Here is what we discovered."

front.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING

"The time has come. You must steal the MEDUSA genome from PEARL. Without it, they cannot create more of the plague.

Additionally, they are executing Operation LION'S TOOTH. One of their control centers is launching weather balloons containing pollen coated in the MEDUSA plague. Find out which control center it is, and stop it at all costs."

back.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING

"Agent Cooper is alive, held by Sabik in San Francisco for the past six months.

Sabik has depleted his resources, allies, and seemingly what little remained of his sanity.

He is now fleeing to Soviet territory, either to defect or to get beyond our reach. He's taking Agent Cooper with him as a hostage; you must bring Sabik in and rescue Cooper if you can.

There will be only one chance to succeed at this. Good luck."

front.transcription:
AT LAST

If you completed both Steal the MEDUSA Genome and Stop Operation LION'S TOOTH, read Debrief 243.

If you completed Steal the MEDUSA Genome but failed Stop Operation LION'S TOOTH, read Debrief 247.

If you failed Steal the MEDUSA Genome but completed Stop Operation LION'S TOOTH, read Debrief 245.

If you failed both Steal the MEDUSA Genome and Stop Operation LION'S TOOTH, read Debrief 252.
